title: fix(plugin-detail): a record on a print page does not print its approval band (objectui#12751)
body:
Fixes #12751
Clause-②: no

## What

On a page that declares `print`, a record in approval no longer prints its approval band. The "Recall approval" button, the "In approval · editable" / "Locked for approval" status badge and the "Approvals — 0 of 1" tally do not reach paper. Off a print page the band is unchanged.

`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` now reads `usePrintPage()` once, above every early return (`isPrintPage`), the way `DetailSection` reads it since PR #12729. The approval band's condition gains `&& !isPrintPage`, so on a print page none of the band is drawn: the badge, the recall button, the tally, the per-group ticks and the recall-error line.

## Why hide the status and the tally, not print them as text

The card leaves this open. The spec answers it:
- Its print-page refusals reject `record:approvals` and `record:approval_decision` because what they show changes per viewer and per decision.
- It rejects `record:path` because the current stage is a field that `record:details` already prints.

The band's badge is host-threaded per viewer (the approvals read, the submitter signal), and its tally moves with every decision. A printed record that should say it is awaiting approval prints the record's own status field through `record:details`. Printing a plain-text badge would add new rendering that nobody has asked for.

## Tests

- New `DetailView.printApprovalBand-12751.test.tsx`:
  - inside a `PrintPageProvider`, for both an editable and a locking approval: no recall button, no `role=status`, no progressbar, and the record's field still renders;
  - CONTROL off a print page: the band, the recall button, the badge text and the progressbar render.
  - Result: 4 passed.
- Ablation with the fix committed (the band condition back to `schema.showHeader === false && (() => {`): `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`. Both print rows went red and both controls stayed green. The file was restored from HEAD; blob 97b55210cfb0 equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail`: 2682 passed, 14 skipped.
- The 37 test files outside plugin-detail that name `DetailView`: 1784 passed.
- After the merge with main: the three approval-band files, 28 passed.

## Local gates

All of these exited 0:
- the closure build for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`;
- the plugin-detail type-check;
- `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:spec-symbols` and `check:new-line-citations`;
- the changeset presence check.

eslint: 0 errors. `DetailView.tsx` has the same warning count as on main, and the new test file is clean.

## Printed page

Setup:
- Published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2` showcase backend.
- A throwaway A4 `print` page on `showcase_invoice`, added in the scratch copy only.
- INV-1010 in its finance and legal sign-off, submitted by the signed-in admin.
- Printed to PDF with Chromium on both the record route and the named page route.

Results:
- Before: the PDF carries "In approval · editable", "Recall approval" and "Approvals — 0 of 1" above the fields.
- After: only the record's fields.

The PNGs are on branch `claude/issue-12751-evidence` under `evidence/12751/`.

## Acceptance notes

- Found on the same PDF, not fixed here: the invoice number does not print. `record:details` hides the record's title field because it assumes a page header draws it, and a print page refuses `page:header`. This is reported for the seat to file.
- Not gated here: `DetailView`'s own header (`showHeader: true`) and the auto-tabs strip. They would print their controls if an author enabled them inside a print page. No producer was measured doing so.
- The approval decision action bar and the Print button do not reach paper today; their host already hides them in print.
